1) preserves our headline rate for 6 months (price hold),

Arielle —

Thanks for the data, that’s very helpful. I’ve pulled this into our renewals playbook and sketched a pragmatic path that balances HelioCharge’s need for burst safety with our pricing commitments:

- Price hold: We can hold your current committed unit price for 6 months from the renewal effective date provided we keep the same baseline commit.
- Credit swap: Convert up to 25% of your unused committed credits into a pooled "burst credit" that can be consumed above baseline at no overage rate for short events (admin window: draws are grandfathered for events <=72 hours).
- Commit cadence: 12-month term with a 10% staged commit uplift in Q2 (months 4–6) that rolls into the baseline; this gives you extra capacity without immediate permanent price change.
- True-up: Quarterly true-up with usage thresholds and an audit log export (we’ll include token-level logs for your finance and security teams).

I’m attaching a short proposed amendment that captures the mechanics and an SLA summary for burst protection (proposed_amendment_20270505.pdf, SLA-Burst-Guard-Terms.docx).

Next steps: I’ll loop in Monica (billing/finance) and Grace (platform/product) to confirm accounting and the technical viability of the burst pool. Could we schedule a 30-minute working session Friday at 10am PT to finalize the amendment and pro forma?

Thanks —

Sean Gallagher
